desc:
Steal a Superstar

One goal: grab the superstar before someone else does.

In Steal a Superstar, it’s not just about running — it’s about speed, strategy, and becoming the strongest rival in the arena!

Chase, outsmart, and collect rare superstars while building your own empire of style and power.

⚔️ Outplay rivals and grab the superstar first
💸 Earn coins to boost your speed and tricks
🌀 Rebirth to unlock new maps and tougher challenges
🛡️ Protect your base — or risk losing your superstars to others
🔥 PvP + Obby + Simulator = total chaos
👗 Buy outfits & funny costumes to flex your style

Can you collect the best superstars and protect your base?
